_description: Unified tax: SS income + pension + spending where withdrawal affects SS provisional income. Tests that portfolio withdrawal pushes PI above threshold, triggering SS taxation.
_rationale: Single filer, Florida, SS $24k + pension $10k (both before_tax) at age 60 + $4k/mo spending ($48k/yr). 0% growth/inflation/stddev. Without withdrawal: PI = (10k + 0) + 12k = 22k < 25k → 0% SS taxable. With withdrawal: PI = (10k + w) + 12k > 25k, pushing SS into 85% zone. Algebraic solution: w ≈ 15856, tax ≈ 1856, ssTaxable ≈ 7778.
name: Unified Tax: SS + Withdrawal
